0.4.0.en: New: Bluetooth fallback – when Wi-Fi or the BLUETTI cloud is down, battery level, power and time remaining are read over Bluetooth (turn it on in the device settings). New: Backup time (Elite 30 V2) and "Full" when the battery is full. Recovers automatically when the power station is re-added in the BLUETTI app. Real-time connection no longer reconnects every few minutes. Better diagnostics, with a "Detailed logging" option.

0.3.1.en: Added link to the Homey Community topic.

0.3.0.en: First public test version. Tested with BLUETTI Elite 30 V2.
